source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals
call_title: RENEW-BOOSTER Eurocluster Call N°2 for Financial Support to Third Parties
executive_summary: Cascade call issued by the RENEW-BOOSTER Eurocluster project, funded by the EU Single Market Programme. Strand A funds individual SMEs from the EU-27 and SMP countries that solve four predefined industrial challenges set by challenge owners (EDF power solutions, Navacel, Estabanell Impulsa, PGE Baltica): robotic repainting of offshore foundations and substation jackets, suction-anchor production for floating wind, second-life batteries and GNSS-independent offshore positioning. In Stage 1, three SMEs per challenge receive EUR 10,000 each (at least 20% private co-funding) for a TRL 6–7 proof of concept; in Stage 2, one SME per challenge receives EUR 50,000 (at least 40% co-funding) to reach TRL 8–9. The deadline is 30 November 2026, 17:00 CET; projects last 3 to 6 months from contract signature, expected at the end of January 2027.
status_rationale: Strand A funds SMEs that develop solutions to four predefined challenges in offshore wind, floating wind manufacturing, batteries and offshore positioning (Call text, 'Call structure and funding strands'; Challenges_Call_2.pdf, Challenges #1–#4). It touches TenneT's field through offshore asset maintenance and inspection, close to the ICCP and Reliability Centered Maintenance project files (robotic stripping and painting of offshore substation jackets, Challenge #1). TenneT cannot take part: only SMEs may apply ('Eligibility criteria'), and the challenge owners of this round are already named, so the call sets out no route for TenneT. C3.2 fits because the robotic maintenance and positioning solutions are products TenneT could later buy, and C3.1 because the strand aims at diversified European supply chains for offshore wind and grid components. The project end date (2027-06-30) was derived from the indicative contract signature at the end of January 2027 and the maximum duration of 6 months ('Timetable and deadlines').
